name: week
title: The legal week
subtitle: What needs a decision, what is waiting and who is carrying it.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select priority,ref,category,detail from v_attention order by priority,category,ref

sections.title: Requests waiting
sections.sql: select ref,title,business_unit,urgency,received_on,days_waiting,status from v_requests where status in ('new','triaged') order by days_waiting desc

sections.title: Team workload
sections.sql: select name,kind,open_matters,high_risk,overdue_steps,requests_to_scope from v_workload order by high_risk desc,open_matters desc

name: dates
title: Dates that cannot move
subtitle: Court, regulator, filing and limitation dates, contract notice deadlines and company filings.

sections.title: Matter key dates
sections.sql: select matter,owner,kind,due_on,days_left,description from v_key_dates where not done order by due_on

sections.title: Contract notice deadlines
sections.note: Notice by is the end date less the notice period recorded. Check the clause itself before relying on it.
sections.sql: select ref,title,counterparty,end_on,notice_days,notice_by,renewal_decision from v_renewals where auto_renews and end_on>=current_date order by notice_by

sections.title: Company filings
sections.sql: select ref,name,jurisdiction,next_due,last_filed_on from v_filings order by next_due

sections.title: Against budget
sections.sql: select matter,name,firm,budget_cents/100 budget,spent_cents/100 spent,disputed_cents/100 disputed,pct_of_budget from v_spend order by pct_of_budget desc nulls last

sections.title: By business unit, last 12 months
sections.sql: select name,requests_90d,open_matters,high_risk,outside_spend_12m_cents/100 outside_spend from v_business_units order by outside_spend_12m_cents desc
